$comment: Auto-generated from src/templates/schema.ts — do not edit manually. Cross-field constraints (cycle detection, unique task IDs, estimation totals) are enforced at runtime only.

field.description: Standard work item field name to evaluate (e.g. 'tags', 'priority', 'state', 'title').

operator.description: Comparison operator. equals/not-equals: exact match. contains/not-contains: substring or array membership. gt/lt/gte/lte: numeric comparison.

value.description: Value to compare against. Can be a string, number, or boolean.

customField.description: Azure DevOps custom field reference in 'Namespace.FieldName' format (e.g. 'Custom.ClientTier').

operator.description: Comparison operator. equals/not-equals: exact match. contains/not-contains: substring or array membership. gt/lt/gte/lte: numeric comparison.

value.description: Value to compare against. Can be a string, number, or boolean.

all.description: Sub-conditions that must all match (logical AND).

any.description: Sub-conditions where at least one must match (logical OR).

version.description: Schema version. Always '1.0' for the current format.

name.description: Unique display name for this template.

description.description: What this template is for and when to use it.

author.description: Author or team that owns this template.

tags.description: Tags for template discovery in the catalog.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this template was first created.

lastModified.description: ISO 8601 date of the last modification.

team.description: Azure DevOps team name. Limits story selection to stories owned by this team.

workItemTypes.description: Work item types to include (e.g. ['User Story', 'Bug']).

statesExclude.description: Story states to exclude from selection.

statesWereEver.description: Include stories that were ever in any of these states.

include.description: Include stories that have at least one of these tags.

exclude.description: Exclude stories that have any of these tags.

tags.description: Tag-based filter — include or exclude stories by tag.

areaPaths.description: Area paths to filter by. Use '@TeamAreas' to match all areas owned by the configured team.

areaPathsUnder.description: Include stories in these area paths and all sub-paths.

iterations.description: Iterations to filter by. Use '@CurrentIteration' for the active sprint.

iterationsUnder.description: Include stories in these iterations and all sub-iterations.

assignedTo.description: Assignee filter. Accepts email addresses or '@Me' for the authenticated user.

changedAfter.description: Include stories changed after this date. ISO 8601 date or date macro (e.g. '@Today-7').

createdAfter.description: Include stories created after this date. ISO 8601 date or date macro.

priority.description: Priority range filter for story selection.

excludeIfHasTasks.description: If true, skips stories that already have child tasks.

path.description: Path to the saved query in Azure DevOps (e.g. 'My Queries/Sprint Stories').

savedQuery.description: Reference an existing Azure DevOps saved query to select stories.

filter.description: Criteria used to select which stories this template applies to.

id.description: Unique identifier for this task within the template. Referenced by 'dependsOn'.

title.description: Task title — shown as the work item title in Azure DevOps.

description.description: Additional details or notes for this task.

estimationPercent.description: Percentage of the parent story's estimate assigned to this task (0–100). Requires estimation.strategy = 'percentage'.

condition.description: Condition evaluated against the parent story. Applied when this condition matches.

percent.description: Estimation percentage used when this condition matches (0–100).

estimationPercentCondition.description: Conditional estimation rules evaluated in order. The first matching condition's percent is used.

estimationFixed.description: Fixed point value for this task, independent of the parent story's estimate.

estimationFormula.description: Expression for dynamic estimation (e.g. 'parent * 0.2 + 1'). Evaluated at generate time.

tags.description: Tags applied to the generated task.

condition.description: Condition evaluated against the parent story. If it does not match, this task is skipped.

dependsOn.description: IDs of tasks this task depends on. Atomize creates predecessor dependency links between these tasks.

assignTo.description: Email address or alias to assign this task to.

priority.description: Priority value for the generated task.

activity.description: Azure DevOps activity type for this task (e.g. 'Development', 'Testing', 'Design').

acceptanceCriteria.description: Acceptance criteria lines for this task.

acceptanceCriteriaAsChecklist.description: If true, acceptance criteria are rendered as a markdown checklist in the task description.

customFields.description: Azure DevOps custom fields to set on the task. Keys must be in 'Namespace.FieldName' format (e.g. 'Custom.ClientTier').

tasks.description: Task definitions that will be generated from this template.

strategy.description: Estimation strategy. 'percentage' distributes the parent story's estimate across tasks proportionally.

source.description: Field on the parent story to read the estimation value from (e.g. 'story-points').

rounding.description: Rounding mode applied to calculated task estimates: 'nearest', 'up', 'down', or 'none'.

minimumTaskPoints.description: Minimum point value any single task can receive after rounding.

ifParentHasNoEstimation.description: Behaviour when the parent story has no estimate. 'skip' omits tasks, 'warn' logs a warning, 'use-default' falls back to defaultParentEstimation.

defaultParentEstimation.description: Fallback estimation value used when the parent story has no estimate and ifParentHasNoEstimation is 'use-default'.

estimation.description: Global estimation configuration for all tasks in this template.

mode.description: 'strict' fails on any validation warning; 'lenient' allows warnings to pass.

totalEstimationMustBe.description: Sum of all non-conditional task percentages must equal this value exactly.

totalEstimationRange.description: Sum of all non-conditional task percentages must fall within this range.

minTasks.description: Minimum number of tasks the template must define.

maxTasks.description: Maximum number of tasks the template may define.

min.description: Minimum allowed estimation percentage for a single task.

max.description: Maximum allowed estimation percentage for a single task.

taskEstimationRange.description: Each task's estimation percentage must fall within this range.

title.description: Required task title. Matched case-insensitively against task titles.

id.description: Required task ID. Checked first; falls back to title match if absent.

requiredTasks.description: Tasks that must be present in the template, matched by title or id.

validation.description: Validation rules applied when this template is used.

category.description: Template category for discovery and grouping (e.g. 'Frontend', 'Backend', 'Infrastructure').

difficulty.description: Complexity level of the work this template targets.

recommendedFor.description: Work item types or story patterns this template is optimised for (e.g. ['User Story', 'Bug']).

estimationGuidelines.description: Human-readable guidance on how to estimate stories before using this template.

examples.description: Example story titles or scenarios where this template applies.

version.description: Template version this changelog entry describes.

date.description: Date of the change in YYYY-MM-DD format.

changes.description: Summary of what changed in this version.

metadata.description: Additional metadata for template discovery and documentation.

extends.description: Name or path of a parent template this one inherits from. Resolved by the Template Library.

mixins.description: Names or paths of mixins to compose into this template. Resolved by the Template Library.
